review_notes: Discover configs in setup.cfg -> tox.ini -> .flake8 order across two directories in order. A malformed setup.cfg must be skipped without polluting later candidates, and a clean setup.cfg must be found. The bug reuses one parser so partial state leaks across candidates. The complete production-file delta is exactly the reviewed repair edit inside this function. Original full-file verification and all requirements retained. Actual diagnosis is not a rejected policy action.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('flake8.options.config')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'src/flake8/options/config.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import os, tempfile
from flake8.options import config
d1 = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d1, 'setup.cfg'), 'w').write('[flake8]\nmax-line-length = 100\n[error\n')
open(os.path.join(d1, '.flake8'), 'w').write('[flake8]\nmax-line-length = 88\n')
r1 = config._find_config_file(d1)
d2 = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d2, 'setup.cfg'), 'w').write('[flake8]\nmax-line-length = 100\n')
r2 = config._find_config_file(d2)
seq = [(r1 or '').endswith('.flake8'), (r2 or '').endswith('setup.cfg')]
print('config_sequence', seq, r1)
assert seq == [True, True], seq
print('flake8_temporal_fresh_parse_per_candidate', True)

PYREPLAY
